title: CPR awareness Programme - MGIT

## CPR awareness Programme

News Date : 17 Apr 2023News ReportNSS Unit of MGIT organized a Cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) awareness programme on 17thApril 2023 in collaboration with Indian Red Cross Society. It was inaugurated by Principal Prof. G. Chandra Mohan Reddy. Students and Staff in large number have participated. The resource persons have explained the importance of CPR in emergency conditions for saving the lives. The techniques that are to be followed were explained in detail with demonstrations. Various first-aid methods also were discussed.
